item.title: Why Claude Code Subagent Worktrees Silently Break Your Git Hooks
item.description: When Claude Code creates a worktree, including a subagent's isolated worktree, it rewrites the relative core.hooksPath in the shared .git/config to an absolute path, so every unpinned worktree runs the main checkout's hooks. Run one idempotent repair script from SessionStart, PostToolUse (EnterWorktree) and SubagentStart; we measured recovery in 68 ms.
